title: OmniPrep™ For High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Blood
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6hbhb6
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add Nuclei Isolation Buffer
steps.instruction: Place up to 500 µl whole blood, buffy coat, bone marrow or packed cells in a 2 ml micro‑centrifuge tube and add 0.75 ml Nuclei Isolation Buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet and Add Buffer
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube to resuspend the pellet and add an additional 0.75 ml Nuclei Isolation Buffer.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at approximately 14,000 g for 30 seconds to pellet the whole‑blood cells and nuclei.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant, Retain Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant containing lysed red blood cells, keeping the pellet in the tube.

steps.title: Mix and Incubate Pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tube to mix, then incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes, inverting the tube every 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Retain Nuclei Pellet with Residual Fluid
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and retain the white nuclei pellet together with 10–20 µl of residual supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse Nuclei with Genomic Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Vortex to resuspend the pellet for improved nuclear lysis and add 500 µl Genomic Lysis Buffer; mix by pipetting or vortex at high speed for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at ~14,000 g for 30 seconds to pellet the nuclei.

steps.title: Incubate at 55‑60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 55–60 °C for 15 minutes (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: OPTIONAL: Add 1 µl Proteinase K per 100 µl Lysis Buffer, then incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours, inverting the tube periodically each hour.

steps.title: Add Chloroform and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl chloroform to the tube and mix by inverting several times.

steps.title: Phase Separation Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 14,000 × g and carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean micro‑centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add DNA Stripping Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNA Stripping Solution to the transferred phase and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5–10 minutes at 60 °C.

steps.title: Add Precipitation Solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution and invert several times; if a white precipitate does not form, add 50 µl aliquots of Precipitation Solution until it appears.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Collect Precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µl isopropanol, and invert the tube 10 times to precipitate the genomic DNA.

steps.title: Optional Mussel Glycogen Carrier
steps.instruction: OPTIONAL: Add 2 µl Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier to improve recovery.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet the genomic DNA.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant, leaving the DNA pellet behind.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash of DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol to the tube and invert several times to wash the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 × g (the pellet may be loosely attached and hard to see).

steps.title: Discard Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Decant or pipette off the ethanol wash solution.

steps.title: Dry Pellet by Inverting
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to allow excess ethanol to drain; do not let the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet in TE Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE Buffer to the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA at Room Temp
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate; optionally incubate at 55–60 °C for 5–60 minutes to speed rehydration.

steps.title: Optional RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: OPTIONAL: Add 1 µl LongLife™ RNase per 100 µl TE Buffer at this stage.

steps.title: Mix and Brief Incubation
steps.instruction: Invert to mix and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, inverting at least twice during the incubation.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at 4 °C for short‑term use; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield: 5–30 µg DNA per ml blood.
